name: Nyli's Valentine's Day
source:
Valentine's Day is coming soon!

Your name is Nyli. Tomorrow, you'll meet Vesper, the boy you've recently found yourself infatuated with.

The thing is, it seems like there's a girl who might be into him, too.

Now, it's up to you to choose how you will deal with her! Will you act correctly to spend Valentine's with Vesper?

[From [url=https://rgbstasis.itch.io/nylis-valentines-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情人节马上就要到了！

你的名字是尼莉。明天，你会见到维斯帕，你最近发现自己迷恋的男孩。

问题是，似乎有一个女孩也可能喜欢他。

现在，你要选择如何对待她！你会正确地与Vesper一起度过情人节吗？

[来自[url=https://rgbstasis.itch.io/nylis-valentines-day]Itch.io[/url]]
